svg.title: Smart cane prototype, exploded view
svg.text: Every part of the cane unit, separated along its assembly direction. Boards, chips, ports and headers at their published sizes. Housing and power bank representative.
SENSOR HEAD, FRONT OF THE HOUSING
10,000 mAh, USB-C PD 5 V 3 A min.
Cables (not drawn): CSI ribbon camera to CAM0, PCIe ribbon HAT to Pi, USB ESP32 to Pi, USB-C power bank to Pi, Dupont leads ESP32 to sensors, motor and button. Wiring table: docs/hardware.md.
